clauses.content: ConstroTrait receives samples solely for laboratory evaluation in accordance with relevant IS / ASTM specifications. Test results relate exclusively to the specimen items sampled or submitted and received at the testing facility.

clauses.title: Payment Terms & Mobilization
clauses.content: 50% advance payment is required upon quotation confirmation prior to testing mobilization or sample processing. Remaining 50% balance must be cleared prior to dispatch of signed formal test certificates.

clauses.title: Turnaround Time & Report Delivery

clauses.title: Liability & Statutory Compliance
